title: feat(spec): RecordRelatedListProps.add — add-existing-via-picker (generic m2m/junction)
body:
A `record:related_list` could only "+ New" (create + navigate). Add an optional `add` config so a related list can LINK existing records via a picker — generic over any relationship:

- **junction/m2m**: pick from `add.picker.object` (the far side) → create a link row in `objectName` as `{[relationshipField]: parentId, [add.linkField]: pickedId}`.
- **1:m**: omit `linkField` → re-parent the picked child (set its `relationshipField` to the parent id).

The canonical use is a generic "Assigned Users" / "Manage Assignments" UI on permission sets (assign `sys_user` → `ai_seat` and every role) — no bespoke editor. Server-side insert rules (e.g. the AI-seat cap) surface inline at the picker.

Pairs with the objectui renderer PR (objectstack-ai/objectui). Spec-only change here.
